name: Tool — Web search (OpenAI built-in)
summary: OpenAI's built-in web_search_preview tool called directly through the Responses API with a BYOM-prefixed model — no Bing connection required.
description: OpenAI-native `web_search_preview` is a built-in Responses API tool supplied in the `tools` array while the request model is `{connection}/{deployment}`. It tests whether Foundry forwards OpenAI's hosted web-search tool through an APIM-routed model call, distinct from Foundry `BingGroundingTool`.
notes:
OpenAI's built-in web search works with BYOM through Foundry — but only the GA `web_search` tool name; the versioned preview names are still rejected.

**GA `web_search` — verified 2026-07-20** against `apim-…-openai-s/gpt-4o-mini` on the Responses API. All three scenarios that historically failed now pass:

- Single-turn call — returns a valid message with a `web_search_call` output item.
- Two searches in one turn — model performs both searches and combines them ("AI headline… cloud-computing headline").
- Two successive requests to the same `conversation` — turn 2 correctly triggers a fresh `web_search_call` (this is the historical regression the previous version of this card described).
- `previous_response_id` chain across two turns — also works.

**Preview / date-versioned names — still blocked.** `web_search_preview`, `web_search_preview_2025_03_11`, and `web_search_2025_08_26` all return the same error:

> `The following tools are not supported with BYO model: <name>. Please remove these tools or use a standard model deployment.`

Guidance for BYOM callers: use `{"type": "web_search"}` unless you specifically need a pinned preview snapshot. This is distinct from Foundry's `BingGroundingTool` (see `tool-web-search`), which requires a Bing connection and is currently rejected across the board by BYOM.
